metadata.title: Damage R0: A Next-Generation Theory of Aging in Interdependent Living Systems
metadata.description: Theoretical preprint defining a multitype damage reproduction operator from damage-generation rates and repair/turnover. It formalizes the local threshold assumptions, a sensitivity-based control objective, and a falsifiable comparative research plan. All numerical results are synthetic; no biological atlas, species-lifespan table, or human cohort was analyzed. The manuscript is not peer-reviewed by virtue of GitHub archival. This file is a Zenodo metadata draft only; no DOI is minted or claimed.
